tool_input.content:
param(
  [switch]$Unregister,
  [switch]$Weekly,
  [string]$At = "03:00",
  [switch]$Push
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$TaskName = "OpenViking-Memory-Snapshot"
$SkillsRoot = "D:\repository\skills"
$Runner = Join-Path $SkillsRoot "scripts\run-openviking-snapshots.ps1"
$Pwsh = (Get-Command pwsh -ErrorAction Stop).Source

if ($Unregister) {
  Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Write-Host "Removed scheduled task: $TaskName"
  exit 0
}

if (-not (Test-Path $Runner)) { throw "Missing script: $Runner" }

$runnerArgs = @(
  "-NoProfile",
  "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass",
  "-File", "`"$Runner`"",
  "-Reason", "scheduled"
)
if ($Push) { $runnerArgs += "-Push" }

$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction `
  -Execute $Pwsh `
  -Argument ($runnerArgs -join " ") `
  -WorkingDirectory $SkillsRoot

$parts = $At -split ":"
$hour = [int]$parts[0]
$minute = if ($parts.Length -gt 1) { [int]$parts[1] } else { 0 }

if ($Weekly) {
  $trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Weekly -DaysOfWeek Sunday -At (Get-Date -Hour $hour -Minute $minute -Second 0)
} else {
  $trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Daily -At (Get-Date -Hour $hour -Minute $minute -Second 0)
}

$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet `
  -StartWhenAvailable `
  -DontStopOnIdleEnd `
  -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Hours 3)

Register-ScheduledTask `
  -TaskName $TaskName `
  -Action $action `
  -Trigger $trigger `
  -Settings $settings `
  -Description "Daily: snapshot-openviking-data + snapshot-openviking-memory → tyvt/skills (see scripts/README-openviking-snapshot.md)" `
  -Force | Out-Null

$schedule = if ($Weekly) { "weekly Sunday $At" } else { "daily $At" }
$gitMode = if ($Push) { "commit + push" } else { "commit only (no push)" }

Write-Host "Registered: $TaskName"
Write-Host "  runner: $Runner"
Write-Host "  jobs: snapshot-openviking-data.mjs, then snapshot-openviking-memory.mjs"
Write-Host "  schedule: $schedule"
Write-Host "  git: $gitMode"

## 计划任务已改为每天同时跑 `data` + `memory`

### Windows 计划任务 `OpenViking-Memory-Snapshot`

| 项 | 配置 |
|----|------|
| **时间** | 每天 **03:00** |
| **执行** | `powershell.exe` → [`scripts/run-openviking-snapshots.ps1`](D:/repository/skills/scripts/run-openviking-snapshots.ps1) `-Reason scheduled` **`-Push`** |
| **顺序** | ① `snapshot-openviking-data.mjs`（全量质量 data，拷 vectordb 前会短暂停 `openviking-server` 再拉起）→ ② `snapshot-openviking-memory.mjs` |
| **日志** | `%TEMP%\openviking-snapshot\` |

### 新增/更新文件（已推远程）

- [`run-openviking-snapshots.ps1`](D:/repository/skills/scripts/run-openviking-snapshots.ps1) — 双快照包装
- [`register-openviking-memory-schedule.ps1`](D:/repository/skills/scripts/register-openviking-memory-schedule.ps1) — 无 `pwsh` 时回退到 `powershell.exe`
- [`README-openviking-snapshot.md`](D:/repository/skills/scripts/README-openviking-snapshot.md) — 说明已更新

**Git**：`ab181bdf` 已推到 `https://github.com/tyvt/skills.git` → `origin/main`

### 手动重装任务（可选）

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:\repository\skills\scripts\register-openviking-memory-schedule.ps1 -Push
```

### 说明

主目录 `D:\repository\skills` 若仍落在旧提交、且 `openviking-memory/` 有大量未提交本地改动，**不影响计划任务**（任务直接跑上述脚本）。若要跟远程对齐，可在确认不需要保留本地 memory 脏文件后执行 `git fetch` + `git checkout origin/main -- scripts/`（或整体 `merge`/`reset`）。

需要把任务名改成更贴切的（例如 `OpenViking-Data-Memory-Snapshot`）可以说一声。
